title: Settings Pagination Label
prompt: A React settings list footer shows the visible item range. Write a helper that returns "start-end of total" for 1-based pages, or "0-0 of 0" when total is 0.

explanation.beginner:
Example: settingsPaginationLabel(1, 10, 25) produces "1-10 of 25". Map each explicitly supported state to its exact output text or value. Separate state selection from formatting.

Compare “labels partial page”: input [3,10,25] produces "21-25 of 25". Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
explanation.junior:
Map each explicitly supported state to its exact output text or value. Separate state selection from formatting.

Tempting mistake: Capitalization, whitespace, and boolean-versus-string output are part of the contract; truthiness alone may combine distinct states.

Trace the branch conditions and any accumulator or lookup after each input. Keep the return contract separate from how it is calculated.

Regression check: preserve the contract illustrated by “labels partial page”, then change one boundary in a new test. The solution below is one implementation; another is valid when it preserves the same behavior.
